title: agentskills.io Discovery Manifest Schema
description: Standard discovery index for progressive disclosure of agent capabilities (RFC 8615 well-known resource).

$schema.description: Normative schema URI per agentskills.io 0.2.0 specification.

name.description: Stable kebab-case identifier matching directory and SKILL.md name.

description.description: Operational summary with explicit 'Use when...' trigger clause.

url.description: Relative path or absolute HTTPS URL to the full SKILL.md or archive.

digest.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of target asset for AST02 integrity verification.

skills.name: configure-agent-skills
skills.description: Creates and manages the agentskills.io manifest index at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json. Use when publishing capabilities.

skills.name: agent-a2a-protocol
skills.description: Implements the full A2A 1.0 task lifecycle including Agent Card discovery and JSON-RPC invoke/stream. Use for agent coordination.
